P.name: Guerrilla Warfare
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Teemo''' gains {{tip|invisibility}} after {{fd|1.5}} seconds without moving, taking non-{{tip|persistent damage|over time}} damage, performing actions that {{tip|break stealth}}, {{tip|channel|channeling}}, or being in {{tip|stasis (buff)|stasis}}. '''Teemo''' will maintain stealth so long as he remains idle and is not {{tip|airborne|displaced}}. While in {{tip|brush}}, '''Teemo''' gains the stealth even while moving and can move without breaking stealth, but will lose the stealth in this case if he is {{tip|airborne|knocked up}}.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Element of Surprise:}} When '''Teemo''' breaks the stealth, he gains {{sti|{{as|{{pp|key=%|20 to 80 for 4|1;5;10;15}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 5 seconds.

Q.name: Blinding Dart
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Teemo''' shoots a dart at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|blind|blinds}} them for a duration.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 260}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}
{{st|Blind Duration|{{ap|2 to 3}} seconds}}
Q.description2: The duration of the {{tip|blind}} is doubled against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.

W.name: Move Quick
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Teemo''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} after 5 seconds without taking non-{{tip|persistent damage|over time}} damage from enemy {{tip|champions}} or {{tip|turrets}}.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Teemo''' doubles the {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} for 3 seconds, preventing it from being removed for the duration.
W.description3: ''Casting Move Quick does not interrupt {{ai|Guerrilla Warfare|Teemo}}.''

E.name: Toxic Shot
E.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} '''Teemo's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and inflict {{tip|poison}}.

{{sbc|{{tip|poison|nolink=true}}:}} The target takes {{as|magic damage}} every second over 4 seconds. Subsequent inflictions refresh the duration.
E.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage On-Hit|{{ap|9 to 65}} {{as|(+ 5% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}}}
{{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|6 to 30}} {{as|(+ {{fd|2.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}}|Total Poison Damage|{{ap|6*4.0 to 30*4.0}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2.5*4.0}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*4.0}}% AP)}}}}

R.name: Noxious Trap
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Teemo''' tosses a poisonous mushroom to the target location that becomes {{tip|stealthed trap|stealthed}} after arming over 1 second, lasting for up to 5 minutes and granting {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings. If the mushroom lands on one that has already been placed, it will bounce forward from the placed mushroom for its cast distance, up to a cap, which can {{tt|happen repeatedly|In-flight mushrooms can chain into further bounces if they keep landing on subsequent placed mushrooms}}.
R.description2: '''Teemo''' periodically [[ammunition|stocks]] a ''Noxious Trap'' charge, up to a maximum amount.
R.description3: The mushroom will explode upon enemy contact, inflicting {{tip|poison}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for 4 seconds, as well as {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them.
R.description4: {{sbc|{{tip|poison|nolink=true}}:}} The target takes {{as|magic damage}} every second over 4 seconds. Subsequent inflictions refresh the duration.
R.leveling4: {{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|200/4 to 450/4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50/4}}% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|200 to 450}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
R.description5: A mushroom has {{sti|health|{{as|6 '''maximum''' health}}}} and can only be damaged by {{tip|champion}} basic attacks (2 damage from {{tip|ranged}} and 3 from {{tip|melee}}).
R.description6: ''See [[Teemo#Pets|Pets]] for more details about mushroom traps.''
